name: ANSI/IEEE three-winding transformer symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for three-winding transformer, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The three-winding transformer form represents three coupled winding circuits with separately documented ratings. Each circuit must remain identifiable where one winding supplies a tertiary load, auxiliary circuit or another specified duty.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Trace all three winding circuits to their destinations.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: Three windings are different from three phase conductors belonging to one winding set.
